static_traits.name: Chen Taiyu
static_traits.social_status: 有少数摄影圈朋友,但谈论自我not足时感到not适
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病史;without既往心理治疗或精神科就诊史
static_traits.language_features: Negative self-evaluation is obvious, with repeated self-doubt and self-labeling; logic is clear, expression coherent, can concretely describe situations and emotions; cooperation is fairly good but the tone tends negative, attention easily captured by ruminative thinking

basic_info.main_problem: 近来总觉得自己是个糟糕的Photographer,尤其是在一次重要拍摄中相机故障之后.这种without能感大约在六个月前开始,在多次拍摄受挫后加重;每当拍摄中出现问题就会怀疑自己的能力.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent self-doubt和without能感开始影响我对摄影的热情和整体心理健康,促使我寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 大约六个月前开始,连续数次拍摄not yet按计划进行,被视为'失败的拍摄',由此逐步形成并Reinforcement了对自身能力的怀疑,负性体验在之后的Work情境中反复被trigger.
一次重要拍摄中相机发生故障,来访者当场感到尴尬,without力与失控,将技术或设备问题个体化为自身能力not足,成为其自我标签化('我是坏Photographer')的关键转折事件.
职业路径以Self-study为主,缺乏正规教育背书,且Living alone,平时not愿与朋友深入谈论自我not足,外在支持与稳定反馈有限,增加了在挫折后对自我价值的脆弱感.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on perfect performance

special_situations.event: During one important shoot, the camera suddenly malfunctioned in the evening after extensive shooting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果拍摄中出现任何技术或设备问题,就说明我技术差,就是个糟糕的Photographer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-blame并把全部问题归因于自己;事后反复观看教程,频繁寻求反馈以弥补not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这当然会发生在我身上,It is all my fault;我就是个坏Photographer

special_situations.event: 过去半年里出现几次not yet按计划进行的拍摄
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有几次拍摄not顺,就证明我整体能力not足且难以改进
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls failure details, ruminates for long periods and lowers the priority of rest and self-care

special_situations.event: After completing a shoot, there are both high-quality works and some small mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有全程零失误才算合格;有错误就等于not成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽略或贬低正面反馈与好作品,只聚焦问题部分,not断自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 好的片子也not算数,这次又被我搞砸了

special_situations.event: When communicating with photography friends or peers and seeking feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我坦露not足或求助,do not人会觉得我not专业,看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避深入谈论自我not足,减少主动求助与社交暴露

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为专业且有价值的Photographer,获得稳定的肯定与支持
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被羞辱,被negate或被客户/同行视为not专业,从而失去机会与关系
defense_goal: Maintains control and avoids facing shame through self-criticism and emphasizing technical problems
减少自我暴露与求助,以降低被评判与Being rejected的风险

object_relations.self_representation: 容易出错,需要证明自己的not够好者
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔,评判且随时可能negate自己的客户或同行

object_relations.self_representation: 脆弱且担心被看not起的求助者
object_relations.object_representation: Peers/friends who may look down on oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to see successes and strengths, or proposes positive reframing and practical preparation suggestions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感觉咨询师在弱化自己的问题,without法理解其失败意味着'I am not good enough'(移情:将过去被negate的体验带入关系)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气低沉克制,强调'技术/能力才是问题',回避羞耻与脆弱的情绪体验;use'也许...但...'的句式来negate积极证据,聚焦技术层面细节.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被鼓励向朋友寻求支持或表达自我not足时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会看not起自己,给出负面评价(将内在的自我批评AnticipationProjection到他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用谨慎而回避的语气,表达'他们会觉得我not专业';减少细节披露,转而强调潜在负面后果以Rationalizationnot求助.

manifestations: Repeatedly questions 'why bother trying', failure experiences overshadow success experiences
Declining enthusiasm; positive feedback hard to internalize
outcomes: Motivation and focus decline; hard to engage in other daily tasks

manifestations: Living alone且较少与朋友讨论脆弱与not足
Tending to avoid seeking help when support is needed
outcomes: 主观支持感not足,Ruminative thinking persists

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将'必须每次拍摄都完美,not能出错'视为硬性标准
Equating occasional equipment failure with personal failure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 在小失误后Excessive self-blame,反复审视自身not足
犹豫表达需求,担心被视为not专业

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 预设朋友会看not起自己的not足,从而Avoiding deep communication
In feedback situations, preconceively interprets others' comments as negative evaluations

exception_events.target_problem: 在重要或压力较大的拍摄中出现问题时,来访者通常会把责任全部归于自己,并据此negate整体能力与作品价值.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在那次相机故障的拍摄里,设备出问题前已拍到多张高质量照片;尽管结尾not顺,但仍产出可用作品.
exception_events.reason: 线索:拍摄前的创意准备与当场的技术发挥使得在出故障前产出优质影像;这些积极结果提示其能力并非由一次意外所negate.

exception_events.target_problem: 在客户或同行评价的情境中,来访者通常会忽视正向反馈,只关注负面细节,进而ReinforcementSelf-doubt.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Previously received clear positive feedback and satisfied evaluations from clients, indicating the work is recognized in certain contexts.
exception_events.reason: 线索:客户的积极评价与已完成的Good拍摄记录,提供外部证据与支持;与其长期坚持练习,寻求反馈的做法共同促成这些好结果.

positive_force: Has creativity and motivation for continuous learning (proactively watches tutorials, seeks feedback)
Has received positive client feedback, showing a certain level of professional ability and replicable success experience
Can propose and implement realistic improvement strategies (such as pre-shoot checks, backup equipment)
Has some peer support network (photography friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Self-doubt与自我标签化严重,将偶发失误等同整体失败
过度概括,个人化与negate积极证据的认知偏差
Excessive dependence on external recognition and high sensitivity to negative evaluations
Avoids expressing vulnerability in supportive relationships, making it hard for support to become a resource

target_behavior.behavior: 反复Self-denial与反刍,出现'我是坏Photographer'的自我标签化
antecedent: Small mistakes or equipment failures while filming
Receives mixed feedback (both positive and negative)
Focusing on flaws when reviewing one's work
target_behavior.core_reason: Binding performance excessively to self-worth, and holding a catastrophizing and overgeneralizing interpretive style toward failure
target_behavior.function: Maintains 'pseudo-control' over the sense of losing control through self-blame and rumination, while avoiding facing shame and vulnerable emotions
target_behavior.consequence: 注意力受损,Work投入下降,客户关系受影响,进一步Reinforcementwithout力与Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding seeking help and emotional expression when support is needed
antecedent: 与同行/朋友讨论not足与挫折的场合
Around the time of external evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心暴露脆弱会被看not起,将内在自我批评Projection为他人负面评判
target_behavior.function: 避免潜在的羞辱或拒绝,维持Self-protection的心理边界
target_behavior.consequence: 主观支持感not足,问题在闭环中反刍扩大,修复与Learning速度变慢
